name: Dairy Farming & Milk Processing
common_threats: Feed price volatility during dry summer seasons
Perishability risk in absence of bulk milk coolers (BMCs)
Bovine disease risks and seasonal breeding cycles
Monopsony dependence on single private middlemen
value_add_opportunities: Paneer and Ghee production (35-45% higher gross margin than liquid milk)
Direct B2B supply agreements with local sweet shops and tea stalls
Probiotic Curd and Flavoured Milk packaging in 200ml pouches
Organic cow dung vermicompost packaging for local nurseries

name: Broiler & Layer Poultry Farm
common_threats: Bird flu/disease breakout rumors impacting consumer demand
Mortality during extreme heatwaves without insulation
High fluctuation in wholesale chicken meat rates
value_add_opportunities: Direct live-bird dressing unit eliminating mandi brokers
Farm-fresh country egg retail counter in 6-pack eco-boxes
Poultry manure packaging for local horticulture farmers

name: Rural Kirana & General Store
common_threats: Capital lock-in due to informal village credit (udhaar)
Price competition from wholesale town traders
Perishable stock spoilage in humid weather
value_add_opportunities: Micro-ATM & AePS cash withdrawal point (generates steady footfall)
Daily fresh vegetable & local farm egg corner
WhatsApp ordering with free doorstep village delivery

name: Tailoring, Boutique & Readymade Garments
common_threats: Highly seasonal demand concentrated around festivals and wedding months
Competition from low-cost mass-produced synthetic readymades from urban hubs
Frequent power outages disrupting motorized machines without inverter
value_add_opportunities: School uniform contracts for local government & private schools
Custom blouse embroidery & designer bridal wear
Fabric-cut piece retailing alongside custom stitching

name: Mini Flour Mill & Spice Grinding Unit
common_threats: Seasonal crop harvest cycle dictating raw spice prices
value_add_opportunities: Cold-pressed virgin mustard/groundnut oil extraction attachment
Pure organic turmeric and chilli powder brand for nearby weekly haats
Job-work grinding charges for local village farmers

name: Two-Wheeler & Agri-Machinery Repair Workshop
common_threats: Credit recovery delays from local tractor/bike owners
Technological changes (EV bikes requiring electronics diagnostics)
Uncertified counterfeit spare parts leading to customer dissatisfaction
value_add_opportunities: Solar water pump & diesel generator servicing contract
Tubeless tyre puncture repair and nitrogen inflation kiosk
Mobile breakdown repair service across a 15km village radius
